integrity: The uniform proof uses explicit clique-prism neighborhood cover, a matching-deleted crown intersection and homotopy pushout. Only the specified open-neighborhood claim is assessed; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Open-neighborhood, finite simple clique prisms \(K_m\square K_2\), integer \(m\ge4\). The excluded small range, other graph products, closed neighborhoods and equivariant homology are not classified. Novelty can be affected by unindexed equivalents. Supporting computations m=4..8 do not substitute for the uniform proof.
title: Open-neighborhood complexes of clique prisms: a mixed-dimensional sphere decomposition
